title: Faberware
text: Faberware. Very disappointed, the cooling rack doesn’t fit like it shows in the picture, covers 3/4 maybe. 1 cupcake pan for 12 only. Feels and looks very cheaply made. Wouldn’t recommend.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Nonstick Bakeware Set Includes Baking Cake Pans and Cookie Sheets, 4 Piece, Gray
features: Set includes an array of essential baking pans for cakes, cookies, muffins, cupcakes, and more
Solid-gauge steel bakeware construction resists warping and dinging for years of baking enjoyment
Nonstick inside and out delivers great food release with quick cleanup
Included Components: 10-Inch X 15-Inch And 11-Inch X 17-Inch Cookie Pans, Two 8-Inch Round Cake Pans
